title: Weil classes and Hodge classes on abelian powers
main_claim: The rational Hodge conjecture holds in every codimension on A^m, for all m, in two cases: (1.1) A is an abelian sixfold with an imaginary-quadratic E-action and a compatible polarization whose homological Hermitian form is hyperbolic of signature (3,3); (1.2) A is any abelian variety of dimension at most 5 with an imaginary-quadratic action. The proof uses the hyperbolic Weil-plane theorem (Markman, reproved in the paper) and the companion CM Hodge theorem.
coverage:
I read Sections 1-3 (lines 1-1836) line by line. This covers the whole reduction from the Weil-plane input to the two main theorems.

Determinant criterion (Thm 2.x):
- the CM-supply lemma and its Hodge-lift splitting
- scalar descent, and the realization of admissible maps and pair tensors
- the Hodge-group tensor stabilizer and the toric-summand lemma
- the first fundamental theorem spanning for Sp/SO/SL
- the simultaneous-balance commuting-projector argument
- the saturation extension

Supply and hyperbolicity:
- the rational hyperbolicity test (Meyer reduction, the rank-2 isotropic vector (t/a,1))
- quadratic determinant supply: padding with CM elliptic curves to determinant -1, then separating slots with the addition map and the [t]^* interpolation projector, then contracting the padding lines

Classification of the derived group:
- the Albert column table, including the signs of the Type II and III forms
- the minuscule two-weight lemma
- small derived projections, including the argument that a quadratic-centre column is not self-dual
- the small column list, including the parity of r_B, the exclusion of b>1 and of (f=1,a=2) by the rank-two mixed-column argument, and the case where E does not embed in K
- independence of the derived images: the intertwiner weight-shift argument, the pure/mixed argument on prime-size Galois orbits, links involving SO4 ideals or a quartic-centre partner, and so6 = sl4

Balance equations: checked for (f,a,g) = (2,2,4), (2,3,6), (3,2,6) (the 3-cycle linear system), and for the cases that fill all of A with odd rank or with E not in K.

Geometric part: I spot-checked the polarized quadratic seed (Prop. in Sec. 5). I verified D0^{-1}T_a^t D0 = -T_a and the homological Gram matrix du·E(v_i,v_j), which is hyperbolic of signature (3,3). The rest of the roughly 6400-line geometric reproof of Markman's theorem (Sections 4-8) was not checked line by line. The main theorems do not depend on that reproof alone, because the statement is also Markman's published theorem.
sibling_notes: Family 032 siblings (CM Hodge conjecture, Kuga-Satake, abelian covers) all reported no_gap_found. This paper's only Hodge-conjecture input is Thm 1.1 of OpenAICM2026, which the rank-116 sibling audited and found no gap in. The Abelian-covers sibling depends on this paper's results (OpenAIAbelianPowers Thm 2.5, the determinant criterion). I found that criterion sound.
